# Coding for Reuse
<!-- Slide 35 -->

## Ideas for Writing Reusable Software {.smaller}

- Save all user input until the next input. Do not transform raw data; you may need it in the future.
- Returning an error code is problematic because it forces the computer to take action at the return. Better to set a class error state and check that. Also consider exceptions.
- Component testing gives you confidence that everything works and that you did not break anything.
- Choose `const` values over literals.
